$comment: Licences allowed in shipped (production) dependencies (SEC-D12, SR-032). Checked by scripts/licence-gate.mjs in CI. Copyleft is denied; an exception names its owner, reason and expiry, and an expired one fails the build (SEC-D14).

unionfs.evidence: node_modules/unionfs/LICENSE: 'free and unencumbered software released into the public domain'; package.json has no licence field

exceptions.reason: libvips, the image library sharp loads through Next.js image handling; dynamically linked, unmodified, replaceable, so LGPL obligations are met by notice. Revisit if Next image optimisation is removed.
The WebAssembly build of sharp, bundling libvips under the same terms as above; installed only where no native build exists.
Commercial document viewer under an evaluation subscription. Production use needs the licence scope decision (R-02); renew or remove by the expiry.
